quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 4,648,227,726.05, up 36.46%, on rising CMP market share and sales plus growth in thinning, ion implant, wet, wafer reclaim, consumables and service businesses; total profit RMB 1,198,123,572.35, up 7.14%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,083,724,706.34, up 5.89%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 964,817,514.21, up 12.69%. Gross margin 41.81%, down 1.39 points. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 912,498,331.19, Q2 RMB 1,037,093,744.55, Q3 RMB 1,244,203,445.71, Q4 RMB 1,454,432,204.60; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 292,301,880.76. Operating cash flow RMB 799,821,228.42, down 30.73% on higher purchase payments and payroll. Year-end inventory RMB 3,988,937,870.25 (+22.08%) and contract liabilities RMB 1,932,270,937.63 (+7.89%, more advance receipts).

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP, 2025 (annual report): the company says it holds over 90% of sales of China-made CMP equipment and covers China's 12-inch advanced lines; advanced-node orders were a large share of new CMP orders; high-end CMP tools passed advanced-node process qualification at several leading domestic customers. New tools: the stacked-layout Universal-S300 and panel CMP Master-P510 / Master-P510APEX for advanced packaging and glass substrates; Universal-300FS for advanced logic won volume orders and Universal-H300 shipped at scale.
quarterly_data.figure: over 90% of China-made CMP equipment sales

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging and HBM tools, 2025 (annual report): some advanced-node CMP tools entered a leading memory maker's HBM production line as baseline equipment, and high-end CMP serves as baseline tools on HBM and 3D-stacking packaging lines; the Versatile-GP300 12-inch thinning-polishing tool (which the company calls a world first) passed 20 units shipped with repeat orders from several leading companies; the Versatile-GM300 thinning and taping tool shipped in volume to several domestic leaders with its first unit accepted in 2025; thinning tools cover most leading domestic fabs and OSATs with a first-mover position in 3DIC and HBM.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other tool lines, 2025 (annual report): 12-inch high-current ion implanters were delivered in volume to several leading domestic IC makers, and the first 12-inch low-temperature implanter iPUMA-LT shipped, completing coverage of all high-current models; ion implant revenue and new orders rose sharply year on year and high-energy implanters are being launched; the implant maker Xinyu became a wholly owned subsidiary. Wet cleaning tools passed customer qualification with revenue recognised and SDS/CDS slurry supply systems won volume purchases; dicing / edge-trimming and edge polishing tools are in process qualification at several leading customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity, 2025 (annual report): the Tianjin wafer reclaim plant's 20 ten-thousand wafers/month is fully loaded (the reclaim project was designed for 10 ten-thousand 12-inch wafers/month and reached 20 ten-thousand by mid-2025); the Kunshan reclaim expansion is planned at 40 ten-thousand wafers/month, with a first phase of 20 ten-thousand. The Beijing plant (thinning, dicing and wet tools) and the Guangzhou plant (core components and slurry supply systems) officially started operation in 2025, and the Shanghai plant is under construction; the Beijing 'IC high-end equipment R&D and industrialization' project (budget RMB 401,512,900.00) was transferred to fixed assets, with its scheduled ready date extended to December 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Tianjin reclaim 20 ten-thousand wafers/month fully loaded; Kunshan planned 40 ten-thousand (phase 1: 20 ten-thousand)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D investment RMB 543,316,118.36, up 37.98%, 11.69% of revenue (1.07% capitalised), the rise mainly from fast R&D headcount growth; R&D staff 876 (33.01% of employees); 569 granted patents at year-end. The largest in-progress R&D project is ion implant equipment, with a planned total investment of RMB 60,111.76 ten-thousand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): push volume shipments of its main CMP models, help new thinning and edge-polishing tools enter leading customers' supply chains at scale, speed up ion implant technology conversion and model qualification, expand into Southeast Asia and other overseas markets with customer qualification, and advance the Kunshan reclaim expansion and the Shanghai project; the company aims to strive within five years for domestic market leadership and a high share in thinning / grinding-dicing tools, ion implanters and wafer reclaim.
